research_question: Can an LLM use model diagnostics to find improvements to the fixed compact MLP more efficiently than conventional tuning, under the same experiment budget?

reference_model.selection_rule: Smallest parameter count within 0.5% of the lowest three-seed mean val_day_mae

arms.gpt_hypotheses: GPT's three predeclared first hypotheses, one change each from the baseline (3 fixed trials)
arms.random: Uniform random search over the shared space
arms.bayes: Optuna Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (GPSampler; 3 random starts after the shared baseline)
arms.llm_batch: LLM proposes every configuration at once from the diagnostic brief, without feedback
arms.llm_feedback: LLM proposes one configuration at a time and receives measured diagnostic feedback

repeats: The pilot runs repeat 1 of every arm. Further repeats reuse this protocol with new random/GP seeds and fresh LLM conversations; gpt_hypotheses is fixed and runs once.

search.objective: Mean over the three folds of score-window equal-date MAE in log-return units
search.baseline: Trial 0 evaluates the baseline configuration once; every arm sees or uses it

fixed_training.lr_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau(factor=0.5, patience=1, min_lr=1e-5) on the tune objective
fixed_training.output_initialization: zero weights and bias, i.e. persistence before training

loss.meaning: Training loss on the scaled target y / std(y_fit)

smooth_l1_beta.meaning: Smooth L1 transition point in scaled-target units; ignored unless loss is smooth_l1

dropout.meaning: Dropout probability after each hidden ReLU layer

sample_weighting.meaning: none weights fit rows equally; date_balanced gives every fit date equal total weight

low_price_weight.meaning: Multiplies the training weight of rows with current close <= 1; weights are renormalized to mean 1

calibration.meaning: Post-training prediction multiplier alpha in [0, 1] fitted on the tune window to minimize equal-date MAE; price_group_scale fits separate alphas for close <= 1 and close > 1

proposers.random: numpy default_rng([repeat, trial]); uniform choices, (log-)uniform ranges

bayes.observations: baseline plus every evaluated trial of the same search

gpt_hypotheses.hypothesis: Training weights individual observations equally, while the selection metric weights dates equally; aligning the training weights with the metric should lower equal-date MAE.
gpt_hypotheses.expected_effect: Lower equal-date MAE, possibly with a small pooled-RMSE cost.
gpt_hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Objective not lower than the baseline configuration.

gpt_hypotheses.hypothesis: The MLP improves large-error behaviour but slightly worsens MAE, so its predictions need shrinkage toward persistence: adjusted = alpha * prediction with 0 <= alpha <= 1.
gpt_hypotheses.expected_effect: Lower equal-date MAE while keeping part of the RMSE gain.
gpt_hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Objective not lower than baseline; alpha = 0 would instead support persistence.

gpt_hypotheses.hypothesis: Almost all squared-error improvement comes from options priced at or below one, so the two price groups need separate calibration coefficients.
gpt_hypotheses.expected_effect: Lower equal-date MAE than one global coefficient.
gpt_hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Objective not lower than the global_scale hypothesis or the baseline.

llm.relay_instructions: Paste each prompt into a NEW temporary chat with memory/personalization off and no browsing or code tools; return the reply verbatim and record the model name.
llm.batch: one prompt asks for all proposals at once; no results are shown
llm.feedback: one prompt per proposal containing every earlier result of the same search

rules: Invalid proposals (after one repair round) and duplicates consume budget
Duplicates of the baseline or of an earlier trial in the same search are not retrained
Identical configurations proposed by different arms reuse the cached result but are charged its original training time and epochs
LLM text never supplies labels or metrics; Python computes every reported number
No prompt contains test-period data or results; the search opens only training dates

confirmation.selection: Per arm and repeat, the evaluated trial with the lowest search objective; ties -> earliest
comparators: baseline configuration under the identical plan and seeds
frozen checkpoint (early-stopped on these dates; reference only)
confirmation.uncertainty: Paired circular block bootstrap over validation dates (block 5, 2000 resamples, seed 8801) of seed-averaged daily MAE differences versus the baseline configuration

final_test.status: Not run. Requires explicit approval after confirmation; each frozen selection is then refit on dates 0-809, tuned on 810-849, and scored once on the reserved June-December 2020 dates

analysis.primary_search: Best-so-far objective after each proposal, and its mean over proposals 1..budget
analysis.primary_confirmation: Seed-mean validation equal-date MAE change versus the baseline configuration
secondary: training epochs and seconds per arm
valid, invalid and duplicate proposal counts
LLM prompt/reply characters (tokens estimated as characters / 4)
Spearman correlation of LLM predicted_change_pct with measured change
subgroup, price-error and RMSE side effects of the selected configurations

caveats: The loss choice l1 lies inside the space, so random sampling reaches it with probability 1/3 per draw; the LLM's value may appear as efficiency rather than discovery.
One search per arm is a pilot: it cannot separate method quality from search luck.
Search uses one training seed. The compact baseline's seed SD of validation equal-date MAE was 0.0000074 (about 0.05%), so smaller differences are within optimization noise.
The original validation dates already guided architecture selection and are summarized in the LLM brief, so confirmation there remains a development estimate.
Manual relay latency includes human time and is not a model-latency measurement.

features.log_high_low: ln(high[t]/low[t]); bar range, not bid-ask spread
features.return_std_5m: Population standard deviation of five one-minute returns from t-4 through t
